observations: Photo 0: White Xbox console with two controllers (one white wired, one black wireless) on top. Console has visible dust and wear. Text 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'BEN ASUENIME' overlaid.
Photo 1: Top-down view of the same console with 'XBOX 360' clearly visible on the front. Power brick and cables are visible to the right. Same watermarks.

Photo 2: Side view of the console standing vertically. Two controllers (white wired, black wireless) beside it. Console shows disc slot, power button, and eject button. A foot is visible in the bottom right corner. Same watermarks.

claims.evidence: No video or photo of the console powered on or in use. No proof of functionality.

claims.claim: with two pads (one wireless and the other wired)
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 2 show one white wired controller and one black wireless controller. The white controller has a cable attached; the black one does not.
Photo 1 shows a black power brick and cables connected to the console.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: Video or photo of the console turned on, displaying the dashboard or a game.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have damaged buttons/sticks
risks.proof: Video of both controllers being used with the console, showing full button response and analog stick movement.
risks.if_unproven: priced as controllers may not work

risks.risk: Console may have internal damage or disc drive issues
risks.proof: Video of the console inserting and playing a disc, or showing the disc tray opening/closing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as disc drive may be faulty

proof_requests: Video of the console powered on and displaying the dashboard or a game.
Video of both controllers being used with the console, showing full functionality.
Video of the disc tray opening and closing, or a disc being inserted and played.
response.reason: The console is identified as an Xbox 360, and the presence of two controllers and a power pack is supported. However, functionality claims are unverified. Without proof of working condition, the item cannot be priced accurately and must be assessed as potentially non-functional until proven otherwise.
